description: Validate a Ghanaian legal citation against the database. Returns whether the cited statute and provision exist. Use this as a zero-hallucination check before presenting legal references to users. Supported formats: "Section 1, Data Protection Act 2012 (Act 843)", "Data Protection Act 2012, s. 1", "act-843-2012, s. 1". Returns: valid (boolean), parsed components, warnings about repealed/amended status.

citation.description: Ghanaian legal citation to validate. Examples: "Section 1, Data Protection Act 2012 (Act 843)", "Cybersecurity Act 2020, s. 1", "act-843-2012, s. 1"

name: validate_citation
